perplexity.description:
Fred Deakin’s Presents The Lasters, released in 2020 on Impotent Fury, is a science-fiction concept album that marks the artist’s first solo venture after his acclaimed work with the Mercury and Brit-nominated electronica duo Lemon Jelly. The album is a sprawling, 75-minute journey across 19 tracks, blending lush electronic textures, ambient soundscapes, and narrative-driven songwriting. Musically, it draws on Deakin’s signature style of melodic electronica, enriched with cinematic flourishes and experimental production, creating an immersive atmosphere that supports its dystopian storyline.

Set in a future where Earth faces extinction and humanity is divided between the Techs and the Luddites, The Lasters unfolds like a modern-day War of the Worlds, weaving a continuous narrative throughout its runtime. The album’s augmented reality visuals and animated accompaniments further enhance its conceptual depth. While not a commercial blockbuster, The Lasters was well-received by critics for its ambition, creativity, and seamless integration of story and sound, solidifying Deakin’s reputation as a pioneering figure in British electronic music.
